course_name: 行動裝置應用程式設計
outline: This course aims to to develop modern Android mobile applications. Android Studio will be the main development platform with the Java programming language to build a complete knowledge system for mobile device development. It also introduces TensorFlow Lite to import basic AI inference functions to understand how to integrate artificial intelligence modules on mobile platforms.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Course and Android Studio
Week 2: Java Programming I
Week 3: Java Programming II
Week 4: Basic Interface and Message Display Components
Week 5: CheckBox, RadioButton, and Spinner
Week 6: ImageView
Week 7: ListView
Week 8: Option Menu
Week 9: Miderm Exam
Week 10: Intent
Week 11: Files
Week 12: Paper Presentation
Week 13: MediaPlayer
Week 14: Database
Week 15: Google API
Week 16: Examples Practices I - Android Studio with AI
Week 17: Final Project Demo
Week 18: Final Project Demo
assessment:
1. Attendance: 10%
2. Homework (Include Quiz  and In-Class Assignment): 25%
3. Paper Presentation: 10%
4. Miderm Exam: 20%
5. Final Project: 35%
